name: ATC 2026

summarization: The International Conference on Advanced Technologies for Communications is an annual conference series co-organized by the Radio & Electronics Association of Vietnam and the IEEE Communications Society. It serves as a premier forum for researchers, academics, and industry professionals to discuss advanced technologies, emerging trends, and research insights in communications. The conference features keynote speakers, technical sessions, tutorials, and exhibits focused on cutting-edge developments in the field.

name: SOICT 2026
full_name: THE 15TH INTERNATIONAL SYMPOSIUM ON INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
summarization: SOICT 2026 is an international symposium covering significant research areas that include AI Foundations and Big Data, Networking and Communication Technologies, Multimedia Processing, AI Applications, Generative AI, Applied Operations Research and Optimization, and Recent Advances in Cyber Security. The symposium aims to provide an academic forum for researchers and graduate students to share their latest research findings and identify future computer science challenges. The event features tutorials and keynotes given by world-class speakers.

name: MAPR 2026
full_name: 2026 International Conference on Multimedia Analysis and Pattern Recognition (MAPR)
summarization: The International Conference on Multimedia Analysis and Pattern Recognition (MAPR) provides a forum for researchers and practitioners from academia and industry to share their latest findings and foster collaborations in AI, pattern recognition, multimedia, and emerging application domains. The conference is categorized into focused tracks covering foundations of AI and machine learning, computer vision, multimedia, language processing, and AI applications in healthcare, cybersecurity, and resource-constrained systems. It is intended for researchers, practitioners, and students working in these fields.

name: RIVF 2026

It provides a venue to share advancements, network, and engage with cutting-edge research in areas such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, computer vision, and cybersecurity. The conference covers diverse topics such as in-memory computing, hardware/software co-design, neuromorphic and bioinspired circuits, computer vision, and emerging AI applications. It aims to support researchers, engineers, and developers working on AI computing platforms from edge devices to cloud servers.

name: APSIPA ASC 2026
full_name: 18th APSIPA Annual Summit and Conference
summarization: The APSIPA Annual Summit and Conference serves as an international forum for researchers, educators, and practitioners dedicated to advancing signal and information processing. It is designed for researchers and industry experts looking to foster collaboration, innovation, and knowledge exchange across the Asia-Pacific region and globally.

name: AICON 2026
full_name: 6th EAI International Conference on Artificial Intelligence for Communications and Networks

It brings together researchers, engineers, and practitioners working at the intersection of AI, communications, and networking, with central themes covering the design, optimization, operation, and protection of wireless, mobile, satellite, optical, Internet of Things, software-defined, and cloud-edge networks.
location: Phu Quoc Island, An Giang, Vietnam

name: CITA 2026
full_name: Conference on Information Technology and its Applications
summarization: The Conference on Information Technology and its Applications (CITA) is an annual international scientific conference focusing on information and communication technology and its diverse applications. It provides a prestigious platform for researchers, practitioners, and educators to exchange ideas, present innovative research, and foster collaborations across topics such as artificial intelligence, data science, networking, and cybersecurity. The 16th CITA 2027 brings together professionals to discuss emerging computing paradigms, smart applications, and digital transformation.

name: ICDV 2026
full_name: The 2026 IEEE 11th International Conference on Integrated Circuits, Design and Verification
summarization: The International Conference on Integrated Circuits, Design, and Verification (ICDV) provides a forum for exchanging ideas, discussing research results, and presenting chips, circuit designs, and applications in solid-state and semiconductor technologies. It focuses on addressing new challenges and leveraging scaling advantages in VLSI architectures, design methodologies, and application systems. The conference is intended for researchers, prospective authors, and professionals interested in integrated circuits and devices.
location: Hanoi, Vietnam

name: TSE 2026
full_name: The 2026 International Conference on Advanced Technologies for Search & Rescue and Emergency Response Systems
summarization: The 2026 International Conference on Advanced Technologies for Search & Rescue and Emergency Response Systems (TSE 2026) provides a forum for exchanging ideas, discussing research results, and presenting cutting-edge innovations at the intersection of science, technology, and emergency management. The conference brings together researchers, engineers, practitioners, policymakers, and industry leaders from around the world to address the increasingly complex challenges of search and rescue operations and emergency response in the modern era.
location: Hanoi, Vietnam

name: ICEEIS 2026

The conference aims to foster dialogue among scholars, policymakers, and practitioners to deliver evidence-based tools, publications, and actionable policy briefs.

name: ICBS 2026

The conference encourages interdisciplinary papers integrating perspectives from business theories, financial practices, governance, innovation, and sustainable development. Key focus areas include ESG, responsible leadership, sustainable finance, corporate governance, and long-term value creation in the digital era.
location: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam

name: ACBES 2026

It is organized as part of the 50th anniversary of the University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City to address themes such as global polycrisis, rapid AI diffusion, geoeconomic fragmentation, and sustainability transitions. The event is intended for PhD students, established scholars, researchers, and journal editors seeking rigorous academic exchange and publication-oriented discussions.

name: VietAME 2026

It is intended for researchers, lecturers, doctoral candidates, and educators.

The event serves as a platform for researchers and practitioners across academia, industry, and policy to share best practices and build impactful collaborations.

The conference promotes international exchanges and highlights scientific advancements in the region.

Bringing together academic researchers, biotechnology innovators, industry leaders, and policymakers, the conference highlights developments ranging from fundamental biological discovery to transformative applications in agriculture, medicine, biotechnology, and sustainability.
